ops.title: A5 gate CLEARED: synckit/reposync/cc-pool mains are sync-RPC compatible; two release gates + machine ordering constraint
ops.body:
Sync-RPC contract recon verdict (sol xhigh, read-only, cites in the session record): released together today, synckit + reposync + cc-pool mains handshake on Synckit RPC schema v1 over daemonkit wire v1. No protocol code must land first.

Design correction to prior notes: synckit main (and v0.35.2) NO LONGER consumes `service.serve_args` — the manifest schema is typed (`service.kind: resident|spawned` + socket + schema_fingerprint + optional `helper.command`); for spawned backends synckitd itself constructs `<binary> rpc-serve-v1 <name>`. cc-pool's active sync path is a RESIDENT helper speaking RPC v1; its hidden `ccp sync rpc-serve` is dead pre-revision proxy code (cleanup debt, not a blocker). `watch.backend` was deleted 07-13 and strict-decode added 07-20 — main still rejects old manifests carrying it, so manifest REGENERATION on the machines is mandatory, not optional.

**Release gates**:
1. Repin reposync + cc-pool (v0.19.1) to the frozen baseline (≥v0.20.1 required — synckit main uses service.StableProgram; the v0.19.1→v0.20.1 delta is service/-only, no wire risk). This is the A4 wave with target v0.20.6.
2. NONE protocol-side — mains agree.

**Machine repair ORDERING constraint (both boxes)**: upgrade synckitd FIRST, then regenerate manifests (`reposync install`, `ccp sync enable`) — synckitd 0.21.0-era binaries expect the old `transport`/`serve_args` shape and reject/misread manifests written by current tooling. Then `synckitd host add` for state, then restart services. (Recipe v3's step order already complies; this note makes the constraint explicit.)
